summary: Implemented the MONAI deprecation decorators. New file monai/utils/deprecate_utils.py provides deprecated (functions and classes), deprecated_arg (argument-level, keyword or positional), DeprecatedError, and version_leq. Warns at or past `since`, raises DeprecatedError at or past `removed`. Exported from monai/utils/__init__.py. Added tests/test_deprecated.py: 11 tests, all passing under the generator venv Python. Also confirmed an existing utils test still runs. Not done: full test suite, CHANGELOG/docs updates. Nothing committed.
